O.outcome_detail: therapeutic empathy on the Helpful Responses Questionnaire

cells.quote: A mixed ANOVA using the general linear model found a significant main effect for the MI training program across all students (F1,51 = 110.83, p < .001). The partial ƞ2 statistic (.685, LL90%CI = .554, UL90%CI = .757) suggested that the training resulted in a large increase in mean therapeutic empathy for all students, in aggregate.
cells.note: The study did not elicit prior MI experience; participants were undergraduate students.

O.outcome_detail: therapeutic empathy on the Helpful Responses Questionnaire

cells.quote: The interaction effect measured the degree to which the change in therapeutic empathy over time was different for the experimental and control groups. This effect was non-significant (F1,51 = 2.12, p = .151), with a partial ƞ2 statistic of .040 (LL90%CI = .000, UL90%CI = .154), a small effect but one with potential practical implication.
cells.note: The self-coding exercise was not superior to the video condition; the non-significant result is coded as inconclusive rather than equivalent.
